regions.merged_text: Today gave Rev. Fr. Walsh 25¢ and dinner. Same is twice "ex Jesuite". seeking a bishop. Resigned to his"misfortune" of failure against every effort where others succeed with less determination he pre- dicts with strongest conviction that having prayed from early childhood for "Confidence in God" he will, in God's own time be Pope of Rome
